method: Both stored branches replayed legally from the FEN; signed material accounting from the side to move at the root; static exchange evaluation at the stored horizon; and a material-only alpha-beta with quiescence continued past the stored horizon to expose recaptures and forks that four plies hide. Verdicts were spot-checked by hand against the board. No detector implementation, packet builder, answer key, or validation snapshot was read.
